Thyroid Hormones
•	 levothyroxine (Synthroid)
Drug may cause appetite changes, weight loss, 
and nausea/diarrhea.
Iron, Calcium or Magnesium may  absorption of 
drug. Soy, walnuts, cottonseed oil, or high fiber 
foods may also  absorption. 
Take Fe, Ca, or Mg supplements away from drug by $ 4 hours; 
take drug 2-3 hours before soy. Eat walnuts, cottonseed oil,  
or high fiber foods away from medication. Use caution with 
grapefruit/related citrus (limes, pomelo, Seville oranges). Take 
drug 30 minutes before a meal. 
Selected Cardiovascular Drugs
Cardiac Glycoside Agent
•	 digoxin (Lanoxin)
Drug may  urinary loss of magnesium and 
 serum levels of potassium.
Hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, and hypercalcemia  drug toxicity. 
Maintain diet high in potassium and magnesium. Monitor magnesium 
levels and use caution with calcium supplements and antacids.
